question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is "around."**
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "Around" **means in or to various places or directions. (विभिन्‍न दिशाओं में चारों ओर, इधर-उधर)

 
 
• Example: *We sat **around**__ the table.*
 
 
 
• The sentence conveys that they carefully molded the clay mold to fit the ready model.
 
• The correct answer is option 3.
 
• Correct passage:

The Chinese rulers were called the Shang. Chinese civilisation is one of the oldest civilisations of the world which __flourished__ in north-east China. The Chinese had thought __**up**__ a very clever way of casting weapons and pots which were made of bronze. These people first made a rough model of the object they wanted to cast or make. Then, they shaped the clay mould closely __**around**__ the prepared model. When the clay was dry, the mould was ______ (4) ______ and cut into pieces. These carved pieces were filled with molten bronze and left to cool down. In the final process, the mould was removed and a perfectly formed object was ______ (5) ______.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Beside: **at the side of, or next to somebody/something. (के बग़ल में, के पास)
 
• **Across: **from one side of something to the other. (एक ओर से दूसरी ओर; आर-पार)
 
• **Behind: **in, at or to the back of somebody/something. (के पीछे, पीछे की ओर)
